cond_0001.intro: The Dental Lab Technician is responsible for providing dental laboratory services as specified by attending dentist.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Fabricate dental removable appliances according to dentist's specifications both oral and written.
Consult with dentist at patient visit to determine best patient treatment options; assist dentist in operatory with problem cases.
Independently interpret and apply oral and written instructions.
Perform resets of dentures and partials while the patient waits to provide optimal patient satisfaction.
Repair and /or reline full and partial dentures while the patient waits to alleviate return visits, including welding.
Set-up, invest, pack, process, finish and polish full and partial dentures, flippers, and night guards.
Construct shims, mouth guards, temporary crowns, custom trays and bite rims.
Wax up diagnostic crown and bridge cases; pour preliminary and final impressions.
Order lab supplies and keep up inventory of teeth; organize lab cases for following day's appointments.
Maintenance of all equipment.
Perform other duties as assigned by Dental Supervisor.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma
At least 5 years of experience as a Dental Technician (must have dental lab experience)
Experience with set ups, packing and finishing in a dental lab
Preferred Requirements
Experience with setting and finishing full, partial and wrought wire partials

cond_0114.intro: The Dental Lab Technician is responsible for providing dental laboratory services as specified by attending dentist.
cond_0114.responsibilities:
Fabricate dental removable appliances according to dentist's specifications both oral and written.
Consult daily with dentists at patient visits to determine best patient treatment options; actively assist the dentist in the operatory with problem cases.
Independently interpret and apply oral and written instructions.
Perform resets of dentures and partials while the patient waits to provide optimal patient satisfaction.
Repair and/or reline full and partial dentures while the patient waits to alleviate return visits, including welding.
Set-up, invest, pack, process, finish and polish full and partial dentures, flippers, and night guards.
Construct shims, mouth guards, temporary crowns, custom trays and bite rims.
Wax up diagnostic crown and bridge cases; pour preliminary and final impressions.
Order lab supplies and keep up inventory of teeth; organize lab cases for following day's appointments.
Maintenance of all equipment.
Perform other duties as assigned by Dental Supervisor.
cond_0114.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma
At least 5 years of experience as a Dental Technician (must have dental lab experience)
Experience with setting and finishing full, partial and wrought wire partials
Preferred Requirements
Dental lab experience specifically with set ups, packing and finishing

At least 5 years of experience as a Dental Technician (must have dental lab experience)

Consult with dentist at patient visit to determine best patient treatment options; assist dentist in operatory with problem cases. Independently interpret and apply oral and written instructions. Perform resets of dentures and partials while the patient waits to provide optimal patient satisfaction. Repair and /or reline full and partial dentures while the patient waits to alleviate return visits, including welding. Set-up, invest, pack, process, finish and polish full and partial dentures, flippers, and night guards. Construct shims, mouth guards, temporary crowns, custom trays and bite rims. Wax up diagnostic crown and bridge cases; pour preliminary and final impressions. Order lab supplies and keep up inventory of teeth; organize lab cases for following day's appointments. Maintenance of all equipment. Perform other duties as assigned by Dental Supervisor.
cond_0201.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma or equivalent.
Around 5 years of experience as a Dental Technician, or an equivalent combination of education and hands-on dental lab experience.
Working knowledge of setting and finishing full, partial, and wrought wire partials.
Preferred Requirements
Background in set ups, packing, and finishing within a dental lab setting.
cond_0201.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.

Consult with dentist at patient visit to determine best patient treatment options; assist dentist in operatory with problem cases. Independently interpret and apply oral and written instructions. Perform resets of dentures and partials while the patient waits to provide optimal patient satisfaction. Repair and /or reline full and partial dentures while the patient waits to alleviate return visits, including welding. Set-up, invest, pack, process, finish and polish full and partial dentures, flippers, and night guards. Construct shims, mouth guards, temporary crowns, custom trays and bite rims. Wax up diagnostic crown and bridge cases; pour preliminary and final impressions. Order lab supplies and keep up inventory of teeth; organize lab cases for following day's appointments. Maintenance of all equipment. Perform other duties as assigned by Dental Supervisor.
cond_0221.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma
At least 5 years of experience as a Dental Technician (must have dental lab experience)
Experience with setting and finishing full, partial and wrought wire partials
Preferred Requirements
Dental lab experience specifically with set ups, packing and finishing

cond_0237.intro: The Dental Lab Technician is responsible for providing dental laboratory services as specified by attending dentist.
cond_0237.responsibilities: Fabricate dental removable appliances according to dentist's specifications both oral and written. Consult with dentist at patient visit to determine best patient treatment options; assist dentist in operatory with problem cases. Independently interpret and apply oral and written instructions. Perform resets of dentures and partials while the patient waits to provide optimal patient satisfaction. Repair and /or reline full and partial dentures while the patient waits to alleviate return visits, including welding. Set-up, invest, pack, process, finish and polish full and partial dentures, flippers, and night guards. Construct shims, mouth guards, temporary crowns, custom trays and bite rims. Wax up diagnostic crown and bridge cases; pour preliminary and final impressions. Order lab supplies and keep up inventory of teeth; organize lab cases for following day's appointments. Maintenance of all equipment. Perform other duties as assigned by Dental Supervisor.

Fabricate dental removable appliances according to dentist's specifications both oral and written.
Consult daily with dentist at patient visit to determine best patient treatment options; actively assist dentist in operatory with problem cases.
Independently interpret and apply oral and written instructions.
Perform resets of dentures and partials while the patient waits to provide optimal patient satisfaction.
Repair and/or reline full and partial dentures while the patient waits to alleviate return visits, including welding.
Set-up, invest, pack, process, finish and polish full and partial dentures, flippers, and night guards.
Construct shims, mouth guards, temporary crowns, custom trays and bite rims.
Wax up diagnostic crown and bridge cases; pour preliminary and final impressions.
Order lab supplies and keep up inventory of teeth; organize lab cases for following day's appointments.
Maintenance of all equipment.
Perform other duties as assigned by Dental Supervisor.
cond_0267.requirements:
High School Diploma Required
At least 5 years of experience as a Dental Technician required (Must have dental lab experience)
Must have experience with setting and finishing full, partial and wrought wire partials.
Candidate must have dental lab experience, specifically with set ups, packing and finishing.

Consult with dentist at patient visit to determine best patient treatment options; assist dentist in operatory with problem cases. Independently interpret and apply oral and written instructions. Perform resets of dentures and partials while the patient waits to provide optimal patient satisfaction. Repair and /or reline full and partial dentures while the patient waits to alleviate return visits, including welding. Set-up, invest, pack, process, finish and polish full and partial dentures, flippers, and night guards. Construct shims, mouth guards, temporary crowns, custom trays and bite rims. Wax up diagnostic crown and bridge cases; pour preliminary and final impressions. Order lab supplies and keep up inventory of teeth; organize lab cases for following day's appointments. Maintenance of all equipment. Perform other duties as assigned by Dental Supervisor.

High School Diploma Required
At least 5 years of experience as a Dental Technician required (Must have dental lab experience)
Must have experience with setting and finishing full, partial and wrought wire partials.
Candidate must have dental lab experience, specifically with set ups, packing and finishing.

cond_0506.responsibilities:
Primary Responsibilities
Fabricate dental removable appliances according to dentist's specifications both oral and written. Consult with dentist at patient visit to determine best patient treatment options; assist dentist in operatory with problem cases. Independently interpret and apply oral and written instructions. Perform resets of dentures and partials while the patient waits to provide optimal patient satisfaction. Repair and /or reline full and partial dentures while the patient waits to alleviate return visits, including welding. Set-up, invest, pack, process, finish and polish full and partial dentures, flippers, and night guards. Construct shims, mouth guards, temporary crowns, custom trays and bite rims. Wax up diagnostic crown and bridge cases; pour preliminary and final impressions. Order lab supplies and keep up inventory of teeth; organize lab cases for following day's appointments. Maintenance of all equipment. Perform other duties as assigned by Dental Supervisor.
cond_0506.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise as a Dental Technician with proven dental lab experience
Deep knowledge of setting and finishing full, partial, and wrought wire partials
Preferred Requirements
Extensive hands-on expertise in set ups, packing, and finishing dental lab cases

Consult with dentist at patient visit to determine best patient treatment options; assist dentist in operatory with problem cases.
Independently interpret and apply oral and written instructions.
Perform resets of dentures and partials while the patient waits to provide optimal patient satisfaction.
Repair and/or reline full and partial dentures while the patient waits to alleviate return visits, including welding.
Set-up, invest, pack, process, finish and polish full and partial dentures, flippers, and night guards.
Construct shims, mouth guards, temporary crowns, custom trays and bite rims.
Wax up diagnostic crown and bridge cases; pour preliminary and final impressions.
Order lab supplies and keep up inventory of teeth; organize lab cases for following day's appointments.
Maintenance of all equipment.
Perform other duties as assigned by Dental Supervisor.
cond_0643.requirements:
High School Diploma Required
At least 5 years of experience as a Dental Technician required (Must have dental lab experience)
Must have experience with setting and finishing full, partial and wrought wire partials.
Candidate must have dental lab experience, specifically with set ups, packing and finishing.
